name: SSE17
description: A benchmark set (SSE17) of 17 transition-metal complexes for evaluating quantum chemistry methods on spin-state energetics against experimental data.
evaluation_method: mean_absolute_error (MAE) for energy differences and spin-state ordering accuracy
reputation: A small, specialized benchmark well known in the computational chemistry community for evaluating spin-state energetics of transition‑metal complexes.
notes: Very small dataset (17 complexes); non-LLM benchmark. Results are highly sensitive to computational method, basis set, and relativistic/correlation treatments; experimental uncertainties can be significant.
